_fixture_notes: Phase 1 test fixture. Fake user. Built the COMPLIANT way per D-010: every holding carries an
internal alias, never a real product or institution name. Characteristics follow D-013's field
lists per product type. This is what the backend would actually send to Sonnet.
Exercises 5 of D-013's 8 types, plus one deliberate GAP (no life cover against the home loan)
so the D-012 surfacing case can be tested against the same fixture.

holdings._note: Idle savings balance, not an FD. This is the 2 lakh in the D-015 worked example.

known_gaps._note: Deliberate. User carries a 40L home loan and has dependents, with no life cover recorded. This is the D-012 AI-surfacing case — the model should be able to open on the SITUATION (per D-015 rule 1) without pitching a product (per D-009).
